title: dfilter: Change default boolean representation to True/False

notes.body:
What is the motivation behind this change? It will make the output visually unaligned (`len("False") != len("True")`).

As the test changes demonstrate, the public interface changes. This likely warrants a release notes entry.

Field (display) representation is not an interface, let's make that clear.

You have a point for the JSON test but now it is using the correct JSON value for booleans (although it should be lower case), so it is arguably a partial fix.

I think it is useful and visually appealing to use a separate representation for booleans from integers. That's the motivation.

It is also now consistent with the field display format, so the added consistency is a nice bonus.

It is unfortunate that the JSON format changed but we should be using "true/false" instead.
